checks.name: surface-type-check-before-emission
checks.detail: every emitted declaration passes LeanRustCore.Surface.checkSurfaceFun before Rust source is produced

checks.name: snapshot-reproducibility
checks.detail: scripts/check-extractor-snapshot.sh diffs generated.rs, differential tests, compatibility report, validation report, target validation, boundary exports, and build metadata against Lean output

checks.name: lean-evaluator-differential-tests
checks.detail: rust/tests/differential_generated.rs compares generated Rust calls with expectations computed by LeanRustCore.IR.eval and LeanRustCore.Surface.evalSurfaceFun

checks.name: safe-rust-subset-gate
checks.detail: scripts/check-rust-validation.sh rejects unsafe, extern boundaries, panic/todo/unimplemented calls, and malformed emitter markers in generated Rust

checks.name: ffi-boundary-exclusion
checks.detail: the direct Lean-emits-Rust path emits ordinary safe Rust only; raw FFI remains outside this compiler path

checks.name: payload-enum-match-lowering
checks.detail: payload enum matches lower through checked branch binders and Rust variant patterns

checks.name: general-pattern-compiler
checks.detail: Sprint-3/4 SurfacePattern and SurfaceExpr.matchPattern lower Bool, Option, Prod, and constructor patterns through a checked general match node before Rust emission

checks.name: constructor-pattern-rust-emission
checks.detail: general constructor patterns emit ordinary safe Rust match arms, including tuple patterns and enum payload binders

checks.name: first-order-call-lowering
checks.detail: calls to tagged first-order Lean declarations lower to checked Rust function calls and dependency-aware emission

checks.name: surface-evaluator-extracted-subset-tests
checks.detail: the SurfaceExpr evaluator covers the current extracted struct, enum, Result, monomorphization, payload-match, structural recursion, and call fixtures

checks.name: extractor-owned-surface-artifact
checks.detail: LeanRustCore.Examples.extractedSurfaceFunctions is emitted by the same extractor command as generated Rust and drives the SurfaceExpr differential expectations

checks.name: rust-identifier-hygiene
checks.detail: Rust identifiers are sanitized for ASCII Rust syntax, keywords are escaped or prefixed, type/variant names use UpperCamelCase, and generated modules are checked for post-sanitization collisions before emission

checks.name: exact-toolchain-pins
checks.detail: Lean toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.22.0 and Rust toolchain 1.85.0 are pinned and checked by scripts/check-toolchain-pins.sh

checks.name: release-fallback-ban
checks.detail: rust/build.rs refuses checked-in generated.rs fallback for CI or release builds; local development fallback requires LEAN_RUST_CORE_ALLOW_FALLBACK=1

checks.name: automatic-monomorphization
checks.detail: generic calls discovered inside concrete exported declarations enqueue and emit concrete monomorphized Rust functions before their callers

checks.name: phase-1-recursion-policy
checks.detail: first-order generated call cycles are permitted in Rust emission; recognized List folds and Nat.rec shapes lower to explicit SurfaceExpr loop nodes, and Lean-side SurfaceExpr differential evaluation remains bounded by explicit fuel

checks.name: parameterized-data-lowering
checks.detail: index-free parameterized structures/enums are monomorphized into Rust structs/enums such as BoxedU32 and TaggedU32

checks.name: standard-container-shapes
checks.detail: Char, String, List, Array, Prod, Sum, and unary function types are represented in RType and lowered to safe Rust type shapes for supported bodies

checks.name: standard-combinator-lowering
checks.detail: recognized List.map/filter/foldl/foldr/any/all, Array.map/foldl, Option.map/bind, and Except.map/bind shapes lower to checked SurfaceExpr nodes

checks.name: structural-recursion-lowering
checks.detail: recognized List folds and Nat.rec accumulator shapes lower to explicit safe Rust loop-shaped SurfaceExpr nodes with evaluator and target-validation fingerprints

checks.name: std-library-lowering-table
checks.detail: records the supported List/Array/Option/Except monomorphic Std lowerings for the current safe Rust lane

checks.name: pure-monadic-do-lowering
checks.detail: records the pure do-notation lowering lane for Option, Except, ReaderT, and StateM without entering unsafe Rust

checks.name: tail-recursion-loop-lowering
checks.detail: Sprint-5/6 recognized Nat accumulator tail recursion lowers to a safe Rust while loop with explicit evaluator fuel accounting

checks.name: list-length-structural-lowering
checks.detail: List.length over the owned List/Vec slice lowers to a checked structural list-length SurfaceExpr node and safe Rust len() cast

checks.name: dependent-shape-erasure
checks.detail: Sprint 10–12 dependent erasure supports Subtype/Fin/Vector runtime carriers and proof-only constructor-field erasure for Eq/True/False/And/Or/Not/Iff/Exists/LT/LE-shaped fields; non-erasable dependent computation remains rejected

checks.name: proof-field-erasure
checks.detail: proof-only constructor fields are excluded from SurfaceStruct payloads and generated Rust structs, while runtime fields remain checked by Surface.typeOfExpected

checks.name: exact-integer-modes
checks.detail: @[rust_nat_exact] and @[rust_int_exact] lower Lean Nat/Int boundaries to num_bigint::BigUint/BigInt instead of fixed-width wrapping integers

checks.name: captured-closure-conversion
checks.detail: captured lambdas in recognized structural combinators are converted into loop bodies whose environments are ordinary Rust locals

checks.name: typeclass-dictionary-erasure
checks.detail: supported resolved typeclass dictionaries are erased from Rust signatures and specialized operations lower to first-order SurfaceExpr nodes

checks.name: transitive-helper-extraction
checks.detail: first-order helper definitions reached from exported declarations are enqueued and emitted as auto-helper-export functions

checks.name: proof-erased-binders
checks.detail: conservative proof-shaped binders such as Eq/True/False proofs are erased from Rust function signatures when their values are not used computationally

checks.name: limited-higher-order-function-pointer
checks.detail: unary function-typed arguments lower to safe Rust fn-pointer arguments and SurfaceExpr.callValue nodes; closures remain a future closure-conversion layer

checks.name: rust-to-target-ir-translation-validation
checks.detail: rust/tests/semantic_validation.rs parses generated.rs with syn, reconstructs the generated-subset target IR, and compares it with LeanRustCore.TargetValidation.targetValidationSnapshot

checks.name: target-validation-snapshot
checks.detail: rust/target-validation.txt records the Lean-side SurfaceExpr fingerprints, Rust-facing declarations, and function signatures used by target validation

checks.name: target-fingerprint-interpreter
checks.detail: rust/tests/target_interpreter.rs executes selected Lean-generated target fingerprints and compares them with compiled generated Rust functions

checks.name: property-differential-seeds
checks.detail: rust/tests/generated.rs and the Lean-generated differential suite include boundary seeds for wrapping arithmetic, payload matches, helper calls, containers, structural List loops, exact integers, and function-pointer arguments

checks.name: ffi-boundary-exporter
checks.detail: LeanRustCore.BoundaryExport emits optional C ABI wrappers for the conservative primitive/result subset; generated wrapper count: 29

checks.name: ffi-feature-isolation
checks.detail: rust/src/ffi_generated.rs is included only under the Rust ffi feature, while default builds continue to compile the direct lane with unsafe_code forbidden

checks.name: ffi-result-status-out-params
checks.detail: Result<u32,u32> raw ABI wrappers lower through ChStatus plus out_ok/out_err pointers instead of exposing native Rust Result across FFI

checks.name: syn-parser-backed-validation
checks.detail: rust/tests/parser_validation.rs parses generated.rs with syn and validates the approved top-level safe Rust subset by AST instead of relying only on text grep

checks.name: json-artifact-parse-validation
checks.detail: rust/tests/validation_report.rs parses validation, compatibility, proof, and build-metadata JSON artifacts with serde_json

checks.name: compatibility-report-output-consistency
checks.detail: rust/tests/validation_report.rs compares compatibility diagnostics and generated function counts against the parsed generated.rs AST
